answer: Proposed gate: each ID earns a daily listing with 10 minutes of exclusive human labor doing echo tests on assigned jade vine trellis posts. Trusted supervisors recognize workers across jobs, time the work and sign ID/day/worker/job/interval receipts. The registry checks signatures, duration and interval nonreuse per worker; failure denies listing. Wages recur; tools are reusable capital; no stake. Collusion can fake service; low wages cheapen IDs and demand caps entry. Ten IDs need 100 human-minutes/day: shared tools or parallel crews cannot credit a minute twice.
